cues: And the verbs that take no preposition, the ones Nepali speakers add one to.
Discuss the problem, never discuss about.
Marry her, or be married to her.
Reach the station, although you arrive at it.
And comprise five members, although it consists of five.
text: And the verbs that take no preposition, the ones Nepali speakers add one to. Discuss the problem, never discuss about. Enter the hall. Marry her, or be married to her. Reach the station, although you arrive at it. Return home, not return back. Resemble his father. Emphasise the point. And comprise five members, although it consists of five.
